name: Interactive Data Lab
description: An interactive portfolio with a data constellation, project observatory, technical journey, and six case studies.
summary: An interactive data-lab direction for the portfolio: connected concepts, project exploration, technical journey, and capability context. The homepage and case-study phases are implemented; final production polish remains.
architecture: Next.js server components render portfolio content. Small client components handle constellation selection, project expansion, and capability filters. Typed content records drive the sections, and Framer Motion supports restrained transitions that respect reduced motion.

capabilities.name: Data constellation
capabilities.description: Explore connected concepts with selection, keyboard controls, and contextual detail.

capabilities.name: Project observatory
capabilities.description: Explore six featured projects and their technical case studies.

capabilities.name: Technical journey
capabilities.description: Browse educational and capability context through reusable portfolio sections.

stack.usage: Server-rendered routes provide the homepage and six technical case studies.
Client components handle node selection, project expansion, and capability filtering.
Typed content models define constellation relationships and portfolio records.
Tailwind theme utilities support responsive graphite and cyan layouts.
Framer Motion provides restrained one-time interface transitions.

architectureConnections.description: Server-rendered portfolio sections embed focused client interactions.

evidence.notes: README explicitly states that the homepage phases and case studies are complete but final production polish remains.
